name: worker-offload
title: Worker Offload Pattern
description: Offload heavy computation to a Web Worker while keeping the main thread responsive.

steps.title: Create Main Thread Bus
steps.explanation: Create a CrossBus instance on the main thread. MessageChannel ports report the fixed origin label "channel". Raise maxPayloadSize deliberately for large arrays; the default budget is 1 MiB.
steps.code: const bus = CrossBus.createSecure({ peerId: 'main', allowedOrigins: ['channel'], maxPayloadSize: 64 * 1024 * 1024 });

steps.title: Create and Connect Worker
steps.explanation: Create a module Worker, bind one end of a MessageChannel to the worker peer and transfer the other port. Wait for the worker's ready signal before sending requests.

steps.title: Setup Worker-side Bus
steps.explanation: In the worker, create a bus with the same payload budget, bind the received port to the main peer and announce readiness.

steps.title: Register Compute Handler in Worker
steps.explanation: Register a handler in the worker for heavy computation.

steps.title: Offload Work from Main Thread
steps.explanation: Send computation request to worker and await result.

tips: Workers can't access DOM - only pure computation
Use Transferable objects for large ArrayBuffers
Consider SharedArrayBuffer for real-time data sharing
